body:
Roy Lee, whose full name is Chungin Lee, is the co-founder and chief executive of the AI assistant company Cluely. He began as a student at Columbia University, where he and co-founder Neel Shanmugam built a tool that coached software engineers through technical job interviews.

Why he is in the news

Cluely launched in April 2025 and raised money from Abstract Ventures, Susa Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz, while the argument over whether its product encourages cheating kept the founder in public view through interviews and podcasts.

Timeline

  • Columbia University: builds Interview Coder, a Chrome extension that supplied AI solutions to coding interview problems.
  • Suspension: the university suspended him over the tool, and he later left.
  • 20 April 2025: Cluely launches, reported at 70,000 sign-ups in its first week.
  • 2025: a US$5.3 million seed round, then US$15 million from Andreessen Horowitz.
